fallback.title: Prefer email?
fallback.body: The studio's business inbox goes live at launch. Until then, the form above is the fastest way to reach us — every submission comes straight to the founder.

confirmation.title: Got it — thanks!
confirmation.responseTime: We'll get back to you within 1–3 business days.
confirmation.emailSent: A confirmation email just went out to the address you entered.
confirmation.troubleshooting: No email within about 10 minutes? Double-check the address for typos and check your spam folder — our real reply will land on the same address.
